On this page, you will find out the best talents for your Mistweaver Monk in World of Warcraft Patch 12.1. We also have default talent builds for various types of content, such as raiding or Mythic+. If you play with Warmode on, we have your PvP talents covered as well.

1.

Best Midnight Talents for Mistweaver Monk

In season 2 of Midnight, Conduit of the Celestials has remained the dominant hero talent selection for Mistweavers in all contexts, however which type of content you are running will drastically alter your options within the spec tree itself.

  • Raid — This build has remained relatively unchanged throughout the season, focusing on a wide proliferation of Renewing Mist across as much of the group as possible. This in conjunction with Vivify cleaves will result in he bulk of your HPS.
  • Mythic+ — As the season has progressed, the once niche "Apexless" build has become the clear favorite to progress through all levels of Keys. Eschewing our Apex talents allows us to pick up extra baseline talents that double down on our "DPS to Healing" play style, with next to no loss in survivability for the group.

Our raid build shines when it a swath of potential Renewing Mist targets, quickly spreading and extending your HoTs with talents like Rapid Diffusion and Rising Mist. Conversely, our Mythic+ build gets it strength from being able to use Spinning Crane Kick buffed by Way of the Crane to turn mass AoE pulls into extremely strong healing throughput.

1.1.

Rising Mist Build

This build's goal is to maintain a large amount of Renewing Mists during our Invoke windows, and aggressively spot healing with Vivify outside of our cooldowns. Rushing Wind Kick also needs to be cast on cooldown to maximize the HoT extension effect it brings.

1.2.

DPS Mythic+ Build

This build skips our Apex talent, and instead allocates those points into talents like Morning Breeze, Emperor's Elixir, and Focused Thunder. The idea is to spend 100% of your Thunder Focus Tea charges on Rising Sun Kick in order to trigger the Jadefire Stomp from Emperor's Elixir. The stomp does a sizable amount of damage that is also converted into healing via Ancient Teachings.

You can either use Thunder Focus Tea on cooldown for max damage, while using the standard Spinning Crane Kick in between for filler, or you can save your charges and use it as a mini-dealing cooldown on large AoE packs.

1.3.

Delve Soloing

The Delves build is largely the same as our Mythic+ Build while taking talents to create distance on your enemies like Crashing Momentum.

In general, you will want to pull as aggressively as you can while using your Ancient Teachings talents and Spinning Crane Kick to keep yourself alive. If you find that your passive healing is being outstripped by your damage intake, then HoT yourself up, and if that's still not enough, then make use of your mobility and Crashing Momentum in order to create some breathing room for you to be able to heal yourself.

It should be noted that Windwalker is likely the superior option for solo delve content, as the moment-to-moment gameplay is extremely similar, but Windwalker will just put out more DPS. In both instances, you will be in melee, hitting Tiger Palm, Blackout Kick, and Rising Sun Kick, however Windwalker at least has a fully fleshed-out damage kit and isn't at the whims of our dear NPC Veleera Sanguinar to follow and attack the correct targets.

1.4.

Master of Harmony Raid Build

This build is not recommended at this time, as Master of Harmony's talents do not scale well in a raid environment. That being said, if you just want to have a little fun and play something slightly different, the MoH build has the same fundamentals as the CotC build, just with a few minor differences.

You will still want to maintain a high uptime on Renewing Mist across your raid, extending your HoTs with Rising Mist, but now your Thunder Focus Tea windows become more important, as each use will provide you with a healing buff.

1.5.

Master of Harmony Mythic+ Build

This build is not recommended at this time, as Master of Harmony's talents do not provide a throughput advantage over Conduit of the Celestials. That being said, if you would like to try out this Hero Talent tree just for fun, here is the recommended build.

You will want to keep Thunder Focus Tea and Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown as much as possible. Spinning Crane Kick will be your go-to healing and DPS button on 5 or more targets, whereas Tiger Palm and Blackout Kick should be used otherwise.

The builds listed above are popular recommendations, covering various different loadouts suited to each style of endgame content. Each Talent Build will have it's own rotation, and can also be manipulated further for specific types of content and to better benefit your group.

2.

Omnium Folio

The Omnium Folio is a system introduced in Midnight's Patch 12.0.7. It unlocks a range of minor customization options that can improve your character's performance after completing a multi-step questline. Some of these bonuses increase your damage output, while others provide defensive benefits. Wrecommend selecting the bonuses listed belowm, however, since you can switch between options freely at any time, don't hesitate to experiment and find the setup that best suits your playstyle if the recommended choices aren't providing the results you're looking for.

  • Week 1: Rune of Unleashed Fire
  • Week 2: Rune of Void-Tainted Shell
  • Week 3: Rune of Lingering
  • Week 4: Rune of Burning Haste
  • Week 5: Rune of Overload
3.

Apex Talent: Spiritfont

Midnight has introduced additional capstone abilities to each spec's tree called Apex Talents. These abilities are separate from the rest of the tree, and require you to be level 81 before you can invest points into them. Mistweaver's Apex talent is called Spirit Font. Below we will list what each of the four ranks of Spirit Font will provide to you:

  1. Spiritfont — Causes your Vivify and Rising Sun Kick to grant you a buff that causes your next Enveloping Mist to channel Soothing Mist onto up to 5 targets at 20% effectiveness. If a target is at max Health, the Soothing Mist will jump to a new target, or split its healing among the other 4 targets.
  2. Spiritfont — Rising Sun Kick damage is increased by 10%/20% and Enveloping Mist healing is increased by 10%/20%. This bonus is increased by 50% while Spirit Font is active.
  3. Spiritfont — Thunder Focus Tea activates Spirit Font, and applies Chi Cocoons to targeted allies at 30% effectiveness.

The effect of Spirit Font is largely passive, however, because its activation is predicated on casting Enveloping Mist, it does pose some conflicts with our Conduit of the Celestials hero talent tree. CotC has us casting Enveloping Mist rationally in order to get value from Strength of the Black Ox. As such, when running Spirit Font, you will need to be aware of your procs and weigh whether or not you want to hold an Enveloping Mist cast for an upcoming damage event in order to line up your Spirit Font healing and shielding.

4.

Hero Talents

Mistweaver Monk has access to two powerful Hero Talent trees, each of which augment out gameplay in different ways. These are Conduit of the Celestials and Master of Harmony.

4.1.

Conduit of the Celestials

Conduit of the Celestials centers around calling forth the power of the August body to empower your spells. These procs such as Courage of the White Tiger cause your rotational abilities to do additional healing and damage, while also triggering secondary effects like Strength of the Black Ox to allow your to shield your group from damage.

It's on-use ability Celestial Conduit is a powerful group wide damage and healing cooldown that you will be able to activate with relative frequency. On a 90 second cooldown you will channel a large amount of healing split between your group, while also dealing AoE damage to any enemies nearby.

4.2.

Master of Harmony

Master of Harmony revolves around storing vital energy within you in order to release it after drinking a Thunder Focus Tea. For the next 10 seconds, this to cause your spells and abilities to do extra damage and healing in the form of a Hot/Dot.

The identity of this talent tree is generally centered on dealing extra damage through passives like Overwhelming Force, and the versatility of being able to spend your stored energy on DPS abilities during times of low HPS requirements.

5.

PvP Talents (War Mode)

PvP talents are PvP-centric options that activate out in the world when you enable War Mode in the talent pane or when participating in instanced PvP content. If you are comfortable with being flagged for PvP, some offer great benefits to questing.

You are permitted to choose three talents from the PvP Talents list. Here is a recommendation of those most helpful for questing.

  • Eminence reduces the cooldown of Transcendence: Transfer by 15 seconds and allows you to port while stunned.
  • Counteract Magic removing hostile magic effects from your target causes you to deal 10% increased healing to them for 10 seconds, stacking up to three times.
  • Refreshing Breeze while channeling Soothing Mist, you can a stacking buff increasing Expel Harm's healing by 15% and allows it to dispel one Poison, Magic, and Disease effect from the target.
  • Healing Sphere places a small orb on the ground that heals friendly targets who walk over it while also removing all harmful magic DoT effects.
  • Zen Focus Tea causes you to be immune to silence and interrupt effects for 5 seconds on a 30-second cooldown.
  • Grapple Weapon allows you to shoot a rope at a target, disarming them of their weapons for 6 seconds on a 45-second cooldown.
  • Alpha Tiger Your first Tiger Palm on a target grants 20% haste for 8 seconds.
  • Dematerialize causes you to take 30% less damage while stunned. This damage reduction decays by 10% per second.
  • Mighty Ox Kick Knocks back your opponent.
  • Peaceweaver Reduces Revival's cooldown by 50% and makes targets hit by it immune to magic for 2 seconds.
  • Thunderous Focus Tea causes Thunder Focus Tea to make your Crackling Jade Lightning's knockback trigger instantly or causes Essence Font to increase your movement speed by 70% and make you immune to movement-impairing effects.
